items.title: Campbell’s or Lululemon: Why One Earnings Report Matters Far More Than the Other
items.summary: Campbell's and Lululemon both report on the same Thursday, but one of those earnings releases carries consequences that will shape an entire portfolio year while the other is just another quarter. Knowing which is which changes everything about how retirees should position right now.
